Editorial publishing

Move a commissioned idea through evidence, review, packaging, approval, publication, and learning.

Audience

The publishing-house tools keep ownership and evidence separate:

1. StoryDesk owns ideas, campaigns, commissions, assignments, handoffs, and queues.

2. Dossier owns claims, sources, evidence, quotes, consent, rights, and freshness.

3. AssetWorks owns media plans, provenance, and accessibility artifacts.

4. BluePencil owns independent review, blockers, verdicts, and calibration.

5. GalleyPack binds exact files, lineage, review evidence, and frozen package versions.

6. VersionSeal binds approval and authority to the exact checksummed version.

7. PressWire owns bounded publication effects, reconciliation, corrections, and receipts.

8. ReaderSignal owns privacy-bounded measurements and evidence-linked learning.

The Publishing House Operator is the durable control loop above these tools and the eleven workflow kits. It is part of the official kujo-workflows 0.4.0 release. It reads StoryDesk, delegates resumable execution to Dispatch, invokes bounded workers through an explicit phase-adapter boundary, validates checksum-bound receipts, records checkpoints, routes exact-version approval, and lets PressWire own publication effects. Publication profiles currently cover the personal blog, kujolang.ai, docs.kujolang.ai, and agents.kujolang.ai without forking the agent roles.
